description: Enable diff statistics display in the git panel by default for all users. This feature should show file change counts (additions and deletions) automatically without requiring users to manually enable the setting.
functional_requirements: Update the default settings configuration to enable diff_stats in the git panel
Ensure the change applies to all new installations and existing installations that haven't modified this setting
Maintain backward compatibility so users who have explicitly disabled diff_stats retain their preference
Verify the diff statistics display correctly in the git panel UI after the change
